answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The timber is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the zephyr. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the trellis of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
